newsitem.title: USA: Cash America to buy back up to 4.5 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: Cash America to buy back up to 4.5 mln shrs.

text.p: Cash America International Inc said Monday it plans to buy back up to 4.5 million shares of its common stock, representing about 15.6 percent of its outstanding shares.
The transaction will be done in a "Dutch Auction" self-tender offer, it said. It was to begin today and expire December 17, the company said.

Under the terms, the company said shareholders can tender shares at prices between $7 and $8.50 per share. Based on the number of shares tendered and the prices specified by shareholders, the company said it will determine the single per share price within that range that will allow it to buy back up to 4.5 million shares.
Cash America said it expects to pay for the offer from cash on hand andd its existing long-term credit facilities.
As of September 30, the company had about 28.98 million shares outstanding.

"We regard the repurchase of our shares as an attractive investment, and it is consistent with our longer term goal of increasing shareholder value," Chairman and Chief Executive Jack Daugherty said in a statement. "Following the repurchase of shares, we will have adequate resources and liquidity to continue to expand our business."
